about.title: Chino Hills Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Chino Hills sits where San Bernardino County meets the Orange County line, and much of its traffic funnels through a handful of routes: SR-71, Chino Hills Parkway, Peyton Drive, and the winding stretch of Carbon Canyon Road. In 2025, the city's public records logged 96 injury collisions, with 131 people hurt and 2 lives lost. Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. show the highest number of reported crashes, which lines up with commuters heading home. If one of those collisions involved you, the days that follow can feel disorganized. Insurers call quickly, repair estimates pile up, and pain sometimes shows up later than expected. LawProactive exists to take one task off your list. Tell us what happened, and we connect you, at no charge, with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims in the Chino Hills area. That attorney works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You decide whether to move forward after speaking with them.

whyChoose.title: Why Chino Hills Drivers Use LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines Are Shorter Than Many Expect
items.desc: California allows two years to file most car accident claims, but if a city, county, or state agency is involved, a written claim may be due in as little as six months. Getting connected early keeps those windows open.

items.title: Partial Fault Does Not Close the Door
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still pursue a claim even if you shared some blame; your recovery is reduced by your percentage, not erased. An attorney can push back when an insurer inflates your share.

items.title: Protecting Your Claim From Day One
items.desc: The other driver's insurer may ask for a recorded statement, and you are not required to give one. An independent attorney from our network can handle that contact while you focus on saving photos, records, and witness details.

items.question: My crash was on Carbon Canyon Road near the county line. Does it matter which side I was on?
items.answer: It can. Carbon Canyon Road crosses between San Bernardino County and Orange County, and where the collision occurred may affect which agency responded, where records are kept, and where a case would be filed. An attorney can sort out those details once they review your report and location.

items.question: Should I talk to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: You can confirm basic facts, but you do not have to provide a recorded statement, and it is usually wise not to until you have spoken with an attorney. Recorded answers given while you are still sore or rattled can be used to question your claim later. Keep your own notes and photos instead.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. Our connection service is free, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they are paid a percentage only if there is a recovery. If there is no recovery, you owe no attorney fee.
